provenance.probe_method: temporary comptime probe in /tmp (zig run --dep vm --dep util -Mroot=probe -Mvm=<worktree>/src/lua/vm.zig -Mutil=<worktree>/src/util/root.zig -O <mode>); LuaFrameState/CFrameState accessed via @FieldType(CallFrame, "u") (decls are module-private); measured in the d8cc5e7 worktree
provenance.puc_probe: /tmp/cisize (gcc against vendored lua-5.5.0 headers, this 64-bit ABI): sizeof(CallInfo)=64

notes: PUC CallInfo is 64 B on this ABI. luazig CallFrame is 88 B in BOTH modes at d8cc5e7 — P16.20 T1 made the layout build-mode-stable (extern struct/union; was Debug 104 vs RF 96 before), and P16.20 T3 then removed the stored `base` field (invariant base == func_slot + 1, derived via frameBase()), shrinking 96 -> 88 B and shifting every field down by 8 (func_slot 8->0, tbc_mark 16->8, activation_id 16, callstatus 28->20, reg_top 32->24, pending_call_index 36->28, u 40->32). LuaFrameState 56 B and CFrameState 56 B (equal arms, extern union, no hidden tag). luazig frames carry architecture-specific state (iterative yieldable execution, inline hook-replay PCs, simple-result continuation, activation_id); 64 B is NOT a target — the model is.
